svg.aria-label: The five MCP roadmap priorities plotted by migration cost and urgency. Priority 3, agent identity and security, is high cost and the one to act on now. Priorities 2 (HTTP-native transport) and 4 (improved primitives) are medium cost and above the midline. Priorities 1 (agentic messaging) and 5 (SDK developer experience) are low cost and ones to watch. Already shipped in the 2026-07-28 release, and not plotted: the stateless core, the Tasks extension and multi round-trip requests.
